source_blocks.heading: What is the largest LEGO piece available?
source_blocks.quote: If you're looking to add this piece to your build, search for the element ID 6421400 on Pick a Brick.
source_blocks.context: Outside of the baseplates, the largest LEGO piece is the Boat Hull, which measures an impressive 28 x 8 x 3 in studs. This large piece provides a solid foundation for creating intricate boat designs and adds significant size to any LEGO build! If you're looking to add this piece to your build, search for the element ID 6421400 on Pick a Brick.

source_blocks.heading: LEGO® Pick a Brick
source_blocks.quote: Whether you're searching for the perfect piece to complete your masterpiece, starting a brand-new build, or customize an existing LEGO® set, it's all possible with Pick a Brick.
source_blocks.context: Unleash your creativity and bring your ideas to life with LEGO® Pick a Brick! Whether you're searching for the perfect piece to complete your masterpiece, starting a brand-new build, or customize an existing LEGO® set, it's all possible with Pick a Brick. Our extensive selection of bricks, plates, tiles, minifigure pieces and more has everything you need. Looking for something specific? You can easily browse by piece type, color , and more so you can find the perfect brick for your next creation. There’s no limit to what you can build!
